name: Abington
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Abington, PA 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Abington, Pennsylvania for 2026: Keswick Village, Glencairn's Nativities and castle tours and the Cairnwood cookie stroll.
lede: Abington and the Bryn Athyn area offer village shopping with Santa, a castle full of Nativity scenes and a Gilded Age estate with a cookie stroll.
celebrates: Abington Township lists Christmas in Keswick Village on its calendar, with pop-up shops, photos with Santa and entertainment along North Keswick Avenue in Glenside. Nearby in Bryn Athyn, Glencairn Museum fills a 20th-century castle with World Nativities and offers a guided Christmas in the Castle tour, while Cairnwood Estate holds a Christmas Cookie Stroll and Children's Critter Quest. The three hosts are within a short drive of each other, so a family can stack a village evening, a museum day and an estate visit across December.
lastyear: We did not find a published 2025 recap for Christmas in Keswick Village, so this page leans on the host calendars. Glencairn's own 2024 event page for its annual Christmas Homeschool Day said the event was sold out, which shows the museum's holiday programs fill up early. A 2023 Bryn Athyn Historic District events flyer lists the Glencairn Christmas Sing concert on Tuesday, December 12, at 8 pm.
facts: Glencairn Museum describes its Christmas in the Castle tour as showing how the Pitcairn family celebrated Christmas at Glencairn for forty years, from the 1940s to the 1970s. The museum says its World Nativities display shows dozens of Nativity scenes from around the world, and its annual Christmas Sing concert has run for more than 80 years. Cairnwood calls itself a Gilded Age estate and lights its rooms with 14 Christmas trees.
trains: Abington does not have its own Christmas train, and we did not find a published holiday train schedule for the area. The closest Santa trains we verified are Santa's North Pole Express at New Hope Railroad in Bucks County, which Visit Bucks County lists from November 20 to December 30, 2026, and Santa's Steam Train Ride, listed from November 27 to December 27. Both are on the New Hope page of this site.
train_links: The 1891 station and heritage railroad in New Hope, listed on our museum guide.
traditions: A village-wide evening with pop-up shops, photos with Santa and entertainment, hosted by the Keswick Village Business Association.
Dozens of three-dimensional Nativity scenes from around the world, shown in a castle.
A 60-minute guided tour of how the Pitcairn family celebrated Christmas.
A concert tradition the museum says has run for more than 80 years.
A self-guided evening at Cairnwood with 14 trees, cookies and a Critter Quest booklet.
kidfact: At Cairnwood, kids hunt for little critters hidden in the rooms with a Critter Quest booklet.
faq: Abington Township hosts Christmas in Keswick Village with Santa photos and pop-up shops, and Bryn Athyn's Glencairn Museum and Cairnwood Estate add Nativity displays, castle tours and a cookie stroll.
What is World Nativities at Glencairn?
It is an exhibition of dozens of three-dimensional Nativity scenes from around the world at Glencairn Museum in Bryn Athyn, which the museum lists from November 27 to January 24.
Is Cairnwood good for children at Christmas?
Cairnwood calls its Christmas Cookie Stroll family friendly and gives out Critter Quest booklets, and it runs a separate Children's Critter Quest on select days in December.
Keswick Village is along North Keswick Avenue in Glenside, in Abington Township, and Abington Township's calendar lists the Christmas celebration there.
intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Abington for 2026, and here is what he found: 5 family events, none of them free. The magic runs from November 27 (Christmas at Glencairn) through January 24, 2027 (World Nativities), with Light Up the Square with Santa in Jenkintown (December 5), Cookies and Cocoa with Santa at Graeme Park (December 6), Christmas in Keswick Village (December 13) and the Christmas Cookie Stroll and Critter Quest at Cairnwood Estate (December 17) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.
